name: Mia hap gung
summary: Mía hấp gừng is sugarcane steamed with ginger. The city portal’s 24 November 2022 page says to order it when the weather is cool or spitting rain. VnExpress, 4 September 2016, says the cane is cut into long pieces and steamed with bruised ginger, and that ngô nướng stalls sell it too.
origin: Vinh. Both the 24 November 2022 city page and the 4 September 2016 VnExpress page treat it as a cool or wet weather snack.
taste: VnExpress, 4 September 2016, says the steamed cane is more fragrant, and softer and sweeter than an uncooked piece.
howToEat: Eat it as a snack in that weather. VnExpress says the cane smells stronger and bites softer and sweeter than raw cane, and that it is better on a rainy day. A street for a stall that sells only the cane was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.
where: VnExpress says many ngô nướng stalls sell it beside the corn. A door number was not printed. Check on arrival.
